passive_localization.prior_tolerance_policy: existing four-Tactical-Turn source FCS loss tolerance; prior received detection is a separate operator snapshot, never raw float success
passive_localization.poor_uncertainty_description: 4-5nm radius circle; no invented exact scalar
passive_localization.fair_special_boundary: two passive-directional Fair needs EER footnote; ordinary two stays Poor
passive_localization.layout: 3-5 passive directional buoys, triangle/square,0.75*modified50 spacing; physical layout is not an uncertainty radius
passive_localization.geometry_policy: only actual received forward-bearing intersections; third consistent original ray required; epsilon is numerical calculation tolerance, not sensor accuracy or a new game radius; nonunique/inconsistent/error-cone geometry stays pending

implementation_policy.selection: field and purpose frozen for the actual Detection TacticalTurn; changed selection/purpose queues for next Plotting boundary; a command processed exactly on the180s boundary precedes Detection and can apply then; stop only disables reception and never refunds current processing capacity; repeating/resuming the same frozen field never earns another budget
implementation_policy.listen_purpose: typed active/search/localization; defaultActive preserves original active command JSON
implementation_policy.alert_consumer: normal physical sonar probability consumes actually received prior Search from a qualified selected monitor before one original float/target/Tac die; no raw float history bonus; perreceiver receipt gate prevents another operator's bonus leaking to unqualified monitors
implementation_policy.passive_source: selected ordinary2Poor/3Good; original passive report remains range-free, aim uses only actual received bearing rays; no truth point or fabricated aircraft native FCS
